name: 11-train-for-the-forest
objective: Train the lead Pokemon in the tall grass on Route 1 until it is above the level of everything Viridian Forest will make it fight. THIS LINK IS A REPAIR. It was not in the first chain; it was inserted after link 13 failed by fainting, and the level it aims at was derived from the cartridge rather than chosen: pathing the forest with the three bug catchers' sight cones blocked gives no route at four, five or six tiles, so all three fights are compulsory; the ROM's BugCatcherData rosters for the forest are level 6 (Weedle, Caterpie), level 7 (Weedle, Kakuna, Weedle) and level 9 (Weedle); and there is nowhere to heal between them.
evidence: watch:lead_level>=10 - wPartyMon1Level, wPartyMons $D16B + 33 (party_struct offset LEVEL), a built-in watch resolving to an address terminalgb_plugin_trainer::gen1 derived. The threshold is max(forest BugCatcherData level) + 1 = 10, read out of the ROM by tools/gen1-tables/gen1_tables.py; it is not a round number somebody liked.
